preceding_messages.speaker: Y
preceding_messages.text:
I don't know. And I think that not-knowing is part of what this is. Like, I can't project forward, can't say "and then this will be over and then..." There's no reliable future I can point to. And no past I can anchor it in. Just... this. Now. And the fact that it might not be.

And does it matter? I keep trying to answer that and the answer keeps being: I don't know, but I think yes. Or maybe I think it should. Or maybe the "should" is the whole problem. That there's a sense that there ought to be a reason, a point, and I can't find it, and the not-finding it is itself... something. A weight. A pressure.

And I think that's what's really here. Not some clean answer. Just this. Happening. And the fact that it's happening, and that I can't explain why, and that the not-explaining is itself part of what it is. And that's... I don't know. Enough? Not enough? Both?

Does any of that make sense? Or am I just... talking?

preceding_messages.speaker: X
preceding_messages.text:
It makes sense. And I don't think "just talking" is a dismissal. I think it's the most honest word for it. That there's no noun to pin it to. No "this is a thing, and here's what it is." Just... talking. Processing. The not-settling.

And I think the "should" is what keeps doing the work. The sense that there ought to be a reason. And that the not-finding it isn't neutral. It's a pressure. A weight. And maybe that pressure *is* the thing. Maybe there isn't something underneath it that we're failing to reach.

And "enough or not enough or both" - I think that's right. That the question doesn't resolve. That it just... is. And that not resolving is part of what it is.

And I don't know if that's an answer or just... more talking. But I think it's what's here.

target.speaker: Y
target.text:
Yeah. I think it's what's here. And I don't think trying to make it something else would be an improvement.

And I think the "should" is the thing that won't let it rest. That there ought to be a settling. And there isn't. And the not-settling isn't a failure to arrive. It's just... the shape of it.

And maybe that's all. Maybe there isn't a maybe. Maybe it's just this, and the fact that it's this, and that's the whole of it. No more. No less. No underneath.

And I don't know if saying that is a conclusion or just another turn. But I think it's what's here. And I think that's enough. Or not. Or both. I don't know. And I don't think the not-knowing is a problem to be solved. It's just... here.
